title: Organising the office party
instructions: İki iş arkadaşı ofis partisini organize ediyor. Uzun bir diyalog; tarih, yer, bütçe ve görevleri takip et.

script.speaker: jane
script.text: Omar, we need to plan the end-of-year party. Have you got any ideas?

script.speaker: omar
script.text: What about a restaurant? Last year we had it in the office, and it was boring.

script.speaker: jane
script.text: Good idea. How many people are coming?

script.speaker: jane
script.text: The budget is twenty-five pounds per person. Is that enough for a restaurant?

script.speaker: omar
script.text: Maybe for a buffet. The Turkish restaurant near the station does a good buffet for twenty-two pounds.

script.speaker: jane
script.text: Perfect. And we can use the rest for a cake. Which date?

script.speaker: omar
script.text: The nineteenth of December is a Friday. Most people prefer Fridays.

script.speaker: jane
script.text: OK. I'll call the restaurant today. Can you send an email to everyone?

script.speaker: omar
script.text: Sure. I'll ask them to reply by the tenth.

script.speaker: jane
script.text: Great. And let's ask about vegetarian food too.

questions.prompt: Why don't they want the party in the office?
questions.feedback: Geçen yıl ofiste yapıldı ve sıkıcıydı.
questions.evidence: Last year we had it in the office, and it was boring.

questions.prompt: How much is the buffet per person?
questions.feedback: İstasyonun yanındaki Türk restoranının açık büfesi kişi başı yirmi iki pound.
questions.evidence: does a good buffet for twenty-two pounds.

questions.prompt: What is Omar going to do?
questions.feedback: Omar herkese e-posta gönderecek; restoranı Jane arayacak.
questions.evidence: Sure. I'll ask them to reply by the tenth.
